items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: he's the one that got me the job with Georgie Auld... Turk Van Lake was in the band. So Turk asked me did I like the band, and I told him, 'Yeah, it sounds all right.' So he says, 'Well, we need a high note man, if you want to join the band.'

ctx.x: I think it was Turk van Lake. In fact, I know it was Turk van Lake, because he's the one that got me the job with Georgie Auld.
Anyway, do you remember any incidents with Charlie other than his gambling? Because he had such a reputation as a wild man...
